name: Cloudflare CDN
free: Unlimited unmetered HTML/CSS/JS bandwidth forever (Free Plan); Pro $20/mo, Business $200/mo
note: Free/Pro plans prohibit serving disproportionate raw video, audio, or S3 binary archives unless using Cloudflare R2, Stream, or Images (ToS Service-Specific Terms).

name: Bunny.net (Standard Network)
free: 14-day Free Trial (1,000 GB bandwidth, no credit card required)
note: $1.00/month minimum account spend; requires $10 minimum balance top-up after 14-day free trial.

name: Bunny.net (Volume Network)
free: 14-day Free Trial (1,000 GB bandwidth, no credit card required)
note: Uses 12 high-capacity regional PoPs instead of 123 edge PoPs; optimized for throughput over ultra-low millisecond edge proximity.

name: Amazon CloudFront (AWS)
free: Always Free: 1 TB data transfer out + 10,000,000 HTTP/HTTPS requests + 2M CloudFront Function invocations per month
note: High list price ($0.085/GB after 1 TB) unless you commit to a 12-month CloudFront Security Savings Bundle or custom enterprise contract; charges $0.0075–$0.01 per 10k HTTPS requests.

name: Gcore CDN
free: Always Free Plan: 1 TB monthly traffic + 1,000,000 requests/month + Free DDoS Protection
note: Free plan caps at 1 TB/month and 1M requests/month; overage requires upgrading to a paid tier starting at $35/mo.

name: Fastly CDN
free: Free Developer Plan: Up to $50/month in free bandwidth and request usage forever
note: High pay-as-you-go bandwidth ($0.12/GB NA/EU) plus $0.0075–$0.016 per 10,000 requests once you exceed the $50/mo free developer credit.

name: KeyCDN
free: 14-day Free Trial (25 GB free traffic, no credit card required)
note: $4/month minimum usage fee; initial credit purchase minimum is $49 (credits roll over for 12 months).

name: CDN77
free: 30-day Free Trial with 500 GB–1 TB test quota
note: Entry plans start at ~$199/month for 6–15 TB bundled traffic; designed for medium-to-high bandwidth workloads rather than hobby sites.

name: Google Cloud CDN
free: $300 Free GCP Trial Credit for new accounts (valid for 90 days)
note: Charges separately for cache egress ($0.02–$0.08/GB), cache fill (origin-to-cache transfer), and HTTP/HTTPS cache lookup requests ($0.0075 per 10k).

name: Microsoft Azure Front Door (Azure CDN)
free: $200 Free Azure Credit (30 days)
note: Azure CDN Classic (Edgio/Verizon) was retired; Azure Front Door Standard has a $35/month base fee plus $0.081/GB egress and $0.01/10k request charges.

name: DigitalOcean Spaces CDN
free: $200 Free Cloud Credit (60 days) + 1 TB outbound transfer included in $5/mo plan
note: Starts at $5/month (includes 250 GiB S3 storage + 1 TiB outbound CDN bandwidth); overage is a flat $0.01/GiB globally with zero per-request fees.

name: Cloudflare R2 + CDN
free: Always Free: 10 GB storage + 1M Class A + 10M Class B operations/mo + Unlimited Free Egress
note: Storage costs $0.015/GB-month after 10 GB free; uncached Class B reads cost $0.36 per million (cached edge hits are 100% free).

name: Akamai Connected Cloud (Ion / Delivery)
free: $100 Free Cloud Computing Credit (Linode/Akamai Cloud)
note: Full Akamai Ion CDN requires enterprise sales contracts; self-serve Object Storage CDN via Akamai Cloud (Linode) includes 1 TB/mo for $5/mo ($0.005/GB overage).

name: CacheFly
free: Free 5 TB/month trial or custom POC for high-volume senders
note: Focused on commercial and high-traffic customers (>10 TB/month); entry packages start around $295/mo.

name: CDNetworks
free: 14-day Free Trial upon enterprise verification
note: Custom quote required for Mainland China cross-border acceleration (ICP filing support).

name: CDNsun
free: 15-day Free Trial (50 GB free traffic, no credit card required)
note: Higher rates in Asia/Australia ($0.05/GB) compared to North America/Europe ($0.02/GB).

name: BlazingCDN
free: Free Trial Credit ($5 test balance upon registration)
note: $5/month minimum spend; smaller PoP footprint in South America and Africa than Bunny.net or Cloudflare.

name: Medianova CDN
free: 14-day Free Trial (100 GB bandwidth)
note: Starter plans begin at $49/month.

name: Imperva CDN (formerly Incapsula)
free: Free Trial available for Enterprise Application Security + CDN
note: Incapsula's legacy free plan was discontinued; Imperva is now bundled as an enterprise WAAP (Web App & API Protection) suite.

name: QUIC.cloud (LiteSpeed WordPress CDN)
free: Always Free Quota: Up to 10–20 GB/mo (LiteSpeed server users) + Free Image Optimization & Critical CSS
note: Full free tier benefits require running LiteSpeed Web Server or OpenLiteSpeed with the LiteSpeed Cache WordPress plugin.

name: ImageKit.io
free: Always Free Plan: 20 GB monthly bandwidth + Unlimited image transformations + 20 GB media storage
note: Free plan caps at 20 GB bandwidth/month; Pro plan starts at $49–$89/mo with overage billed per 20 GB or 100 GB pack.

name: Cloudinary
free: Always Free Plan: 25 Monthly Credits (~25 GB bandwidth OR 25,000 transformations OR 25 GB storage)
note: Uses a unified Credit system (1 Credit = 1 GB bandwidth OR 1,000 transformations); Plus plan is $89/mo (225 credits), Advanced $224/mo (600 credits).

name: Imgix
free: Free Trial (1,000 Origin Images)
note: Billed by unique Origin Images + Bandwidth quota; Starter tier begins at $75/month.

name: Sirv Media CDN
free: Free Plan: 500 MB storage + 2 GB/month CDN transfer (with watermark on 360 spins)
note: Free plan has 500 MB storage limit; Business plans start at $19/mo for 5 GB storage and 20 GB transfer.

name: jsDelivr
free: 100% Free Forever for Open-Source npm & GitHub packages (Unlimited traffic within fair use)
note: Only serves public npm packages, GitHub release/repo files (<50 MB per file), and WordPress plugins; cannot be used as a private origin pull CDN.

name: cdnjs (Cloudflare Open-Source CDN)
free: 100% Free Forever (Unmetered bandwidth for 4,500+ curated open-source libraries)
note: Only hosts curated libraries approved in the cdnjs GitHub repository; arbitrary npm or GitHub files require jsDelivr or unpkg.

name: UNPKG
free: 100% Free Forever for any file published to the npm registry
note: Single-CDN architecture (no Multi-CDN failover like jsDelivr); strictly mirrors npm registry packages.

name: esm.sh (Modern ES Module CDN)
free: 100% Free Forever for open-source ES Modules from npm &jsr
note: Designed for ES module import statements and import maps rather than legacy script tags.

name: Google Hosted Libraries
free: 100% Free Forever (Google infrastructure)
note: Only hosts ~20 core libraries (jQuery, AngularJS, D3.js, Three.js, WebFont Loader); blocked in Mainland China.

name: Statically.io
free: 100% Free for open-source GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket & WordPress SVN assets
note: For public Git repositories and open-source projects only.

name: OVHcloud CDN
free: Included with select OVHcloud Hosting or $11/mo base + unmetered traffic options
note: Best integrated with OVHcloud Public Cloud S3 or OVH Dedicated Servers.

name: Scaleway Edge Services
free: 75 GB Free Object Storage Egress/month
note: Pipeline base fee applies per configured Load Balancer / Bucket endpoint.

name: Hetzner Object Storage + Cloudflare (Zero-Egress Stack)
free: 1 TB Outbound Traffic included in €4.99 (~$5.39/mo) base plan
note: Hetzner S3 charges only ~€1.00/TB ($0.001/GB) for egress; pair with Bunny.net or Cloudflare Cache for global edge caching.

name: Backblaze B2 + Cloudflare / Bunny.net (Bandwidth Alliance)
free: First 10 GB B2 Storage Free Forever + 3x Storage Free Egress + $0 Egress to Cloudflare/Bunny/Fastly
note: Egress from Backblaze B2 to Cloudflare, Fastly, and Bunny.net is 100% free ($0.00/GB) under the Bandwidth Alliance; you only pay $6/TB/month for stored data.

name: Bunny Stream (Video CDN + Transcoding)
free: 14-day Free Trial (Free HLS transcoding & customizable HTML5 player)
note: Requires $1/month minimum spend; storage is $0.01/GB per replication region.

name: Cloudflare Stream
free: Included in Creator bundles or $5/mo per 1,000 mins stored
note: Billed per minute ($5 per 1,000 minutes stored + $1 per 1,000 minutes delivered) regardless of 720p vs 1080p bitrate.

name: Mux Video CDN
free: $20 Free Credit + 100,000 Free Encoded Minutes/month (Starter Promo)
note: Billed per minute of video delivered (~$0.0009/min at 1080p) plus storage ($0.003/min/mo).

name: Alibaba Cloud CDN
free: Free Trial Package (50 GB–100 GB for new verified accounts)
note: Delivering via Mainland China PoPs requires a valid Chinese ICP Filing (ICP Beian); Near-China (Hong Kong/Singapore) requires no ICP.

name: Tencent Cloud EdgeOne
free: Free Trial / Starter Plan from $9.90/month
note: Mainland China nodes require ICP license; Global (Excl. Mainland China) plan works immediately without ICP.

name: Oracle Cloud (OCI) 10 TB Free Outbound + Akamai CDN
free: Always Free: First 10 TB/month of Outbound Data Transfer is $0.00/month in every OCI region
note: Requires credit card verification at signup; OCI native egress includes 10 TB/mo free — pair with Cloudflare or Caddy for global edge caching.

name: Vercel Edge Network
free: Hobby Free Plan: 100 GB Fast Data Transfer/month + 1,000,000 Edge Requests/month
note: Hobby Free plan is strictly for non-commercial use; Pro ($20/mo) includes 1 TB transfer, then charges $0.15/GB overage.

name: Netlify Edge CDN
free: Starter Free Plan: 100 GB bandwidth/month + 300 build minutes/month (Commercial use allowed)
note: Severe bandwidth overage trap ($55 per 100 GB = $0.55/GB!) once you exceed the 100 GB Starter or 1 TB Pro quota.

name: Cloudflare Pages Edge CDN
free: 100% Free Unlimited Static Bandwidth & Unlimited Requests (Commercial use allowed)
note: Maximum 25 MB per individual static file and 20,000 files per deployment on the Free plan.

name: NOC.org Anycast CDN & WAF
free: 14-day Free Trial
note: Created by former Sucuri founders; focuses on security + website caching rather than raw multi-terabyte video VOD.

name: Sucuri Firewall & Anycast CDN (GoDaddy)
free: 30-day Money-Back Guarantee
note: Billed per website domain ($199.99/yr Basic or $9.99/mo WAF+CDN) rather than pure per-GB object storage CDN.

name: Jetpack Site Accelerator (formerly Photon by Automattic)
free: 100% Free Unlimited Image (WebP) & Static JS/CSS CDN for WordPress sites
note: Only caches WordPress images (i0.wp.com) and core/plugin static assets; cannot purge individual image URLs without renaming the file; VideoPress requires paid plan after 1st video.
